tldr: Chiron transiting the 4th house: a long healing chapter around home, family, roots, and emotional foundations.
body: Chiron moving through the 4th house can reopen old material around home, family, belonging, ancestry, privacy, and the emotional ground a person stands on. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix.
business: For a year or more, an old wound around home, family, and roots may resurface to be worked through. Treated carefully, the healing becomes wisdom that can later support others.
shadow: Picking at the wound, reopening it without integration, or numbing out around home and family instead of tending what hurts.
advice: Tend the sore spot in home and family deliberately. This is the work, and it can become something you later help others understand.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
